newsitem.title: ITALY: Piedmont Int chief executive Barberis resigns.
newsitem.headline: Piedmont Int chief executive Barberis resigns.

text.p: Piedmont International SA, the parent company of Olivetti Personal Computers, on Monday announced the resignation of its group chief executive Alessandro Barberis.
An Olivetti PC statement said that, after succesfully completing the first major steps in the turnaround of the PC company, Barberis had chosen to leave the company to pursue other interests.

Until Piedmont appoints a new group chief executive, Olivetti PCs will be managed by an executive committee made up of Bernhard Auer, board member of Piedmont, and two senior executives Gian Piero Vaccarono and George Culioli.
Piedmont completed the purchase of Olivetti PCs from Olivetti earlier this year.
